headline: Approved general assistance maximums for FY 2026-2027 and spending for traffic signals, a fire truck, and trail projects.
summary: Council confirmed Bruno Inácio as Finance Director. Six other orders passed first reading, and a review of PFAS testing at three athletic fields was given with no vote taken.
decisions: Approved purchase of portable traffic signals for Public Services, 6-0-1.
Confirmed the appointment of Bruno Inácio as Finance Director, 6-0-1.
Adopted the Annual General Assistance Ordinance and set the maximums for FY 2026-2027, 6-0-1, after a public hearing where no one spoke.
Accepted the unappropriated funds report for 4th quarter FY 2026, 6-0-1.
Passed first reading of the award of bid for a replacement medium-duty pick-up truck for the Fire Department, 6-0-1.
Passed first reading of authorization to accept federal asset forfeiture funds, 6-0-1.
Passed first reading of an expenditure to Presumpscot Regional Land Trust for Mill Brook Preserve improvements, 6-0-1.
Passed first reading of an expenditure for the Portland Trails Rock Row Connector Trail, 6-0-1.
Passed first reading of Task Order No. 11 with Credere Associates for Riverwalk North, 6-0-1.
Passed first reading of amendments to several orders on the Landslide Vulnerability Assessment Project and the vendor list, 6-0-1.
